data.name: Silencing Strike*
data.description: When the investigator deals damage with a studied strike, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC %1) or be unable to speak (even for verbal components) for 1d4+1 rounds. A successful save reduces the duration to 1 round. This talent has no effect on creatures immune to critical hits. An investigator must be at least 15th level to select this talent.|10+InvestigatorLVL/2+INT
